name: Ida Marlow
subject: Digest
body:
Hello,

How do I point the weekly digest at a different folder in the shared shelf?

The current folder still receives the file, and I would rather read it beside the photos.

A short note on which setting to edit is enough for me.

I can open the digest itself and the photos without trouble from this seat.

The paper copy in the drawer is the same digest as last spring.

The drawer labels were rewritten last winter and I still find every binder by those labels. The side room keeps a second copy of that same digest for guests who arrive after the reading. I do not need a new digest, only the folder change.

Thanks,
Ida Marlow
Quillhaven Press

name: Nils Adler
subject: Summary
body:
Hello,

How do I move the monthly summary into the cabinet beside the photo drawer?

The summary still lands in the old cabinet, and the producers read the other one.

A short note on which setting to edit is enough for me.

I can open both cabinets from this seat and the pages look unchanged.

The printed summary from April still matches the screen.

The cabinet stickers were lettered by hand and I still follow those stickers. A second summary already sits on the windowsill for anyone who missed the meeting. I only want the landing cabinet changed.

Thanks,
Nils Adler
Harborlane Studio

name: Helena Voss
subject: Shelves
body:
Hello,

How do I send the studio notes to the north shelf instead of the east shelf?

The east shelf still collects them, and the binders live on the north shelf.

A short note on which setting to edit is enough for me.

I can open a note directly and the text is intact.

The handwritten index in the drawer lists the same shelves.

The index cards were copied in pencil and I still trust that pencil list. Guests can already read a note if I hand them the binder. I only want the destination shelf changed.

Thanks,
Helena Voss
Larkspur Studio

name: Petra Holm
subject: Trays
body:
Hello,

How do I keep the visitor copies in the blue tray rather than the grey tray?

The grey tray still fills up, and the front desk reads the blue one.

A short note on which setting to edit is enough for me.

I can open a copy from either tray and the words match.

The wall card still names the blue tray as the one we hand out.

The wall card was painted last autumn and I still point visitors to it. A spare copy already lives in the blue tray for late arrivals. I only want the tray choice changed.

Thanks,
Petra Holm
Cinderwharf Bindery
